title:
It worked fine on localhost.
`process.env.API_SECRET`
is undefined in production.
subtitle: The local `.env` had all 48 secrets hardcoded since May. The production secret manager had a typo in the variable name (`API_SEKRET`) that was silently ignored by the initialization wrapper.
logs: > attempting to authenticate with database using undefined...
> DB response: 'FATAL: password authentication failed for user root'.
> fallback logic activated: using empty string "".
> security scan: panic triggered across all clusters.
footnote: Error code: `ENV-UNDEFINED-404` · Root cause: `.env.production` was never committed
pathTemplate: `{path}` relies on an environment variable that only exists on one developer's desktop.
